jumps.why: The clause gives one formula for a force farther than d from the member end and another for a force within d of it, 5k against 2.5k, with no transition between them: away from the end the force spreads through the web on both sides of the bearing length, near the end on one side only.

not_written.why: The equation needs a sine: it raises the sine of the angle between the force and the weld axis to the 1.5 power, and the language has no sine. In this edition (page 16.1-130) Equation J2-5 gives the directional strength increase factor kds = 1.0 + 0.50 sin^1.5(theta), which multiplies the nominal stress Fnw in Equation J2-4; it is not itself a nominal stress, as the 2016 edition's J2-5 was. Either form needs the sine.
